scenes.chapter: Chapter 1  The orphan who loved sport
lines: Orphaned as a boy, he was raised by his uncle.
Later, he studied at McGill University in Canada,
fell in love with sport, and became a gym teacher.
In 1890, he moved to Springfield, Massachusetts,
In eighteen ninety, he moved to Springfield, Massachusetts,
to teach at the YMCA training school.
New England winters are long and cold,
and his students, stuck indoors, were bored.
His boss gave him a challenge: in fourteen days,
invent a new game that could be played indoors.

items.caption: Ideas at the desk on a winter night

lines: He asked for two boxes to use as goals,
but the janitor brought two peach baskets instead.
He nailed them to the gym balcony, about three meters up,
and wrote thirteen rules for the notice board.

lines: In December 1891, eighteen students split into two teams,
In December eighteen ninety-one, eighteen students split into two teams,
nine a side, throwing a ball at the high baskets.
It was the first basketball game in the world.
In 1898, he joined the University of Kansas,
In eighteen ninety-eight, he joined the University of Kansas,
and became its first basketball coach.

In nineteen thirty-six, basketball joined the Olympics for the first time,

Today, from school gyms to street courts,
people all over the world are shooting hoops.
His question for you:
if you had just fourteen days, what would you invent?
